# Student Hybrid replanning V1

Student owns evidence, cumulative mastery, learner intent, safe path application and next action. Learning Planner owns significance and the proposed consequence. Operational Hybrid Policy V1 is accepted; no global automatic-replanning preference is introduced.

## Narrow boundaries

`POST /internal/v1/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/hybrid-consequences` accepts strict `planner-hybrid-consequence.v1` using the dedicated Planner credential. General Course, Teacher and Practice credentials cannot apply a Hybrid consequence.

Learner `POST /api/v1/student/learning-paths/{pathID}/learning-intents` and `GET /api/v1/student/learning-paths/{pathID}/learning-intents/{intentID}` use the existing trusted gateway actor headers and STUDENT/STUDENT_PRO role gate. This is the existing gateway identity boundary, not JWT verification. No internal service creates learner consent.

The durable intent binds exact student, path, expected revision, kind and requested scope/mutations. Exact replay returns the initial receipt; changed payload under the same ID conflicts. One unconsumed intent may exist for a given path revision. Its bounded optional projection participates in the repeatable-read planning snapshot and learner content address. Absence preserves the previous hash format. A stale intent cannot authorize a newer revision.

## Atomic applicability and history

Student compares current policy, path revision, coherent snapshot content address, exact goal/direction/stacks, intent provenance and protected work. AUTO changes only future PLANNED slots. READY, IN_PROGRESS, completed/skipped history, frozen assignments and any OPEN/RESERVED binding are protected. The existing blanket T02/T03 structural guards retain their original behavior.

Hybrid persistence updates only changed future slots and appends one path revision and one immutable application receipt in one transaction; it does not delete/reinsert the entire path. Position swaps use temporary positive positions inside the transaction. Replaying a terminal receipt returns the original receipt even after later owner changes. A changed payload conflicts. Any applicability or transaction failure leaves the previous path intact.

NO_CHANGE stores a receipt without a path revision. An explicit active-work request may persist as WAITING_SAFE_BOUNDARY without consuming its intent or changing the path/TaskInstance. Retry occurs at the ordinary lifecycle boundary. If that boundary changes the path revision, a fresh learner intent is required. No Runtime hold, pause/resume or TaskInstance cancellation is added.

Future replacement/insertion uses an existing immutable authored template. Remediation requires accepted prerequisite-gap provenance. No content selection, CourseVersion mapping, new gap threshold or fabricated track field is introduced; unavailable transitions fail closed with typed errors. A matching SUBSTANTIAL_SCOPE_CHANGE can authorize a defined future-only same-scope transition at a safe boundary.

## Rollout

Apply Student migration 032 before deploying the new snapshot/applicability reader. Apply Planner migration 022 before deploying the delivery worker. Preserve prior 020/021 state and provision the canonical planning-state stream before starting the consumers. Rollbacks refuse retained intent/application/delivery state; use only isolated proof databases for up/down/up verification.

The native Student forward runner excludes `.down.sql` files and retains legacy `.sql` plus `.up.sql` ordering/checksum semantics. Migration032 has the first paired rollback file; it is never selected by ordinary `migrate up`.

## Composed verification (T20.5)

The root-only `TestT205ActualHybridComposed` consumes the real Student outbox event through canonical NATS/JetStream and the production Planner consumer, snapshot/evaluation/application processors and PostgreSQL stores. It reads the registered Student coherent snapshot, evaluates the real pinned policy/graph, applies through the registered Student boundary and reads the actual Student NextActionResolver. A–G cover a single failed Course application yielding NO_CHANGE, stable independent execution yielding future AUTO, exact redelivery, a genuine owner-snapshot stale race, OPEN Practice preservation and ordinary safe completion, exact learner intent and recovery after owner commit with a lost response.

`TestT205HybridOwnerProvider` is a finite integration provider, not a production endpoint. Named initial authored metadata enters owner creation APIs; completed history enters actual theory acknowledgement. Practice evidence envelopes, Course official outcome/Teacher independent context, the Runtime execution projection and trusted gateway identity headers are bounded upstream fixtures. The Course join uses the actual registered Teacher assistance NATS subscriber. Transport faults and delivery scheduling are proof instrumentation. Neither final Evidence/Mastery/Path truth nor immutable Planner jobs/outcomes are seeded. This is scoped owner-boundary verification; it does not claim full platform live E2E or actual Runtime validation execution.
